research_question: can historical confidence-aware pacing plus causal cross-episode evidence make the frozen reduced joint Human identifier useful

gamma.semantics: Goal-MPC planning velocity ceiling only: gamma*[15,25] deg/s

trust_authorities.current_nominal_model_high_evidence: completed future comparison establishes challenger statistically worse than nominal
trust_authorities.qualified_shadow_challenger: nominal remains low confidence because challenger is not authorized for control

stop_rules.qualified: stop after a shadow publication supported by its preregistered future blocks
stop_rules.repeated_minimum_pacing_abort: stop after two consecutive aborts only if cumulative clean integral blocks remain below the 16-block first-fit minimum

identifier.implementation: unchanged reduced shadow v1 fit/challenger/embargo/trust settings

decision_rule.P_A: all three formerly early-aborting conditions reach a fit and at least three of four nonnominal conditions publish within five repetitions without truth
decision_rule.P_B: at least one formerly early-aborting condition reaches a fit with increased cumulative information, but P_A publication evidence is not achieved
decision_rule.P_C: no formerly early-aborting condition reaches useful fit information, or session estimates are unstable/inconsistent
